payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort pitches, compute adjacent gaps, sort gaps; sort queries by interval length; sweep through gaps to accumulate contributions, computing distinct count as (length+1)*(n - gap_count) + gap_sum.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts differences and queries by range length to enable a sweep line: for increasing query lengths, add gaps ≤ length to a running sum, then compute answer. No binary search or custom key sorting beyond basic ordering.
